newsitem.title: USA: PDVSA, Science Applications in joint venture.
newsitem.headline: PDVSA, Science Applications in joint venture.

text.p: State-owned Petroleos de Venezuela, S.A., (PDVSA) announced that Science Applications International Corp would help manage its computer and data operations, a lawyer for the oil firm said.
The lawyer, Mark Gordon, on Thursday declined to discuss the terms of the joint venture, but said PDVSA would own 40 percent of the private commecial venture, and Science Applications 60 percent.
PDVSA entered the venture to improve efficiency and take advantage of South America's growing technology market, Gordon said.
Science Application, an employee-owned technology company based in San Diego, will manage PDVSA's software and data operations and seek ventures with other Venezuelan and South American companies.
PDVSA, the world's eighth-biggest oil company, is worth about $26 billion, according to Gordon. Science Applications is valued at around $2.2 billion.
